notes.title: Dragon Marked for Death has been updated to Version 3.0.7s!
notes.notes:
Ver.3.0.7s (Updated May 8, 2020)

* An issue that would cause a excessive messages regarding status effects to appear in the log under certain conditions has been fixed.

* An issue causing explanation, rarity, and effect text on equipment in the Weapon Shop, General Store, and Black Market to appear incorrectly has been fixed.

* For events that cannot be skipped, the text will now be fast forwarded at the same speed as normal dialogue.

The latest update, Ver.3.0.7s, will be required for internet play at the Bar for both Open Matching and Friend Matching.

notes.title: Dragon Marked for Death has been updated to Version 3.0.6s!
notes.notes:
Ver.3.0.6s (Updated May 1, 2020)

* An issue that would cause mouse controls to become unresponsive has been fixed.

* An issue where keyboard controls would not work when assigning buttons/keys has been fixed.

* An issue where the equipment effect "Recover xx％ DP when taking dmg" was not properly applied when successfully guarding attacks or receiving non-knockback damage has been fixed.

* An issue where the frame rate would drop below 60 FPS on some PCs when using Quick Commands has been improved.
　(This issue may not be completely resolved yet depending on your PC. We are continuing to look into the issue.)

The latest update, Ver.3.0.6s, will be required for internet play at the Bar for both Open Matching and Friend Matching.

notes.title: Dragon Marked for Death has been updated to version 3.0.4s
notes.notes:
Ver.3.0.4s (Updated April 27, 2020)

* An issue that was causing the game to crash after language settings were changed at the Inn has been fixed

* An issue that was causing the "Regen Healing Up" effect on equipment to not work properly has been fixed

* An issue that was causing the "Recover DP When Taking Damage" effect to not work properly on items equipped in the Oracle's magic focus equipment slot has been fixed

* An issue that was causing the attack power of the Oracle's "Thurst Form" and "Guard Form" attacks to not update when she changed her equipped greatsword during a quest has been fixed

* An issue that allowed players to get stuck in the terrain during the "Frozen Fusion" quest has been fixed

The latest update, Ver.3.0.4s will be required for internet play at the Bar, both Open Matching and Friend Matching.

notes.title: Dragon Marked for Death has been updated to version 3.0.2s
notes.notes:
Ver.3.0.3s (Updated April 24, 2020)

* An issue where the "Ancient Gauntlet +5" item could not created using the upgrade system has been fixed

* An issue that was causing the upgrade gauge of certain accessories to not increase after a successful upgrade has been fixed

* An issue that was causing some English text to not display properly has been fixed

* Some unclear Tutorial text has been fixed

notes.title: Dragon Marked for Death has been updated to version 3.0.2s
notes.notes:
Updated to Ver.3.0.2s

Ver.3.0.2s (Updated April 23, 2020)

 An issue where the Witch could cast Condense and LV3 spells while equipped with a magic focus has been fixed

 An issue that was causing periodic framerate drops for players whose PC meets the minimum spec requirements in single-player (offline) play has been fixed

* The latest update, Ver.3.0.2s will be required for internet play at the Bar, both Open Matching and Friend Matching.

notes.title: Dragon Marked for Death has been updated to version 3.0.1s.
notes.notes:
Updated to Ver.3.0.1s


Ver.3.0.1s (Updated April 22, 2020)

* An issue when using internet matchmaking where "Worldwide" functioned identically to "Same Region" matchmaking has been fixed.

* An issue where quests in internet matchmaking could be started with parties larger than 4 has been fixed.
　（Parties greater than 4 members can no longer start quests）

* An issue where room numbers could not be set in internet matchmaking has been fixed.

* An issue where the M.Acc.Up effect on equipment would be activated when below the equipment level has been fixed.

* Performance issues causing drops below 60 FPS have been addressed.
　（Some players may still experience this issue; we will continue to investigate the problem）

* Some issues with game text have been fixed.


For players who do not see the Striker Gear early purchase bonus equipment for sale in the slums weapon shop, the following steps may fix the issue.

 1) Open the properties for Dragon Marked for Death in the Steam client.
 2) In the DLC tab, uncheck the install checkbox next to the Striker Gear DLC.
 3) Check the checkbox for the Striker Gear DLC once again.

After doing this, the Striker Gear equipment may appear in the slums weapon shop.
Cases where this does not fix the issue are still being investigated.
